messages.subject: [Basta-users] Error with simulation to find jump sd's
messages.subject_clean: [Basta-users] Error with simulation to find jump sd's
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am trying the simplest possible analysis with BaSTA with my own data using the following comand:

out<-basta(object=marmot.dat,studyStart=2007,studyEnd=2014)

but it gives me the following error message:

No problems were detected with the data.

Starting simulation to find jump sd's... 
Error in if (acceptCrit > acceptProb) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

DataCheck tells me that the data is fine. 
Anyone knows how to fix this?

Thanks a lot,

Achaz von Hardenberg 
Alpine Wildlife Research Centre
Gran Paradiso National Park

messages.body_plain:
Hi Achaz,

  I found the problem, in record 19 you had a 2 instead of a 1 on the recapture column for year 2013. This was making BaSTA to assign awfully high times of death? This is the first time we have this bug, we?ll make sure to include a check for this kind of problems in the DataCheck() function. Thanks for reporting this!

Best,

Fernando
